name: Mrs. Kerr
excerpt: Mrs. Kerr is a perky blond woman who replaced Mrs. Dodds as the pre-algebra teacher.
notes: Mrs. Kerr is the new pre-algebra teacher at Yancy Academy, having replaced the mysteriously vanished Mrs. Dodds. Her sudden appearance adds to Percy's growing sense of confusion, as he struggles to reconcile his memories with the altered reality around him. The other students act as if Mrs. Kerr has been their teacher since Christmas, despite Percy never having seen her before. This dissonance contributes to his feelings of paranoia and isolation, as he is haunted by the memory of Mrs. Dodds, whom he is convinced existed. Mrs. Kerr's role, though minor, serves to maintain the illusion of normalcy at the school while deepening Percy's sense of being out of sync with the world around him.
